'''Tynnan''' was the [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]]. In addition to their own language, Tynnans also spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="EGTPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tynnan language was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and released in [[1998]].<ref name="EGTPM" />
